name: retire-pre-0616-trellis-compat
title: Retire the pre-0.6.16 vendored Trellis compatibility layer
description: The fleet converged on Trellis 0.6.16-sd.7, so the dual-version wrappers, the status collector's current --json fallback chain, the create --base-branch prohibition, and the 0.6.7-emulating tests are all dead weight; record that exact build as the supported floor in the compatibility spec and remove what the floor authorizes.
